tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.
Tenders from Joint ventures are not acceptable
Conditional tenders will not be accepted.
The tenderer shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender, and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs.
The cost of the Tender Processing shall not be refundable.
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing E - Procurement Portal.
The Tenderers need to register with e-procurement portal and to obtain user ID and Password for participating in e-procurement.

The EMD & Tender processing fee shall be paid through e-procurement portal only using any of the four modes. 1) Credit Card. 2) Direct debit using Internet banking 3) NEFT( National Electronic Fund Transfer) 4) OTC (Over the counter using bank challan).
Bank Guarantee will not be acceptable for EMD. EMD should be paid as specified in the e-procurement schedule.
In all matters of dispute the decision of the University is final and legally binding.
The Authority reserves the right to Accept or Reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reason.
The University of Mysore does not bind itself to Accept the lowest bidder and this University reserves the right to Accept or Reject any of the Tender or all the tenders without assigning the reason.

The quoted price should be inclusive of all types of taxes GST, (service tax, VAT, sales tax), Customs duty, clearance charges, transportation, erection (commission), excise duty etc., & all incidental charges etc., which are applicable F.O.R Mysore-570006, KARNATAKA STATE, INDIA.
Interested tenderers can get the information through the following web portal https://www.kppp.karnataka.gov.in
IMP: THE QUANTITY MENTIONED IN THE TENDER IS SUBJECT TO CONSIDERATION. (The Quantity may vary according to the requirement at the time of procurement)

The EMD and Security Deposit are liable to be forfeited as liquidated damages in the event of any evasion, refusal or delay on his/her part in signing the contract form. The other terms and conditions are as stipulated in Standard Tender Document of government of Karnataka K/g3.

Liquidated Damages: Subject to GCC Clause 24, if the Supplier fails to deliver any or all of the Goods or to perform the Services within the period(s) specified in the Contract, the Purchaser shall, without prejudice to its other remedies under the Contract, deduct from the Contract Price, as liquidated damages, a sum equivalent to 0.5% of the delivered price of the delayed Goods or unperformed Services for each week or part thereof of delay until actual delivery or performance, up to a maximum deduction of 10% of the Contract Price.. Once the maximum is reached, the Purchaser may consider termination of the Contract pursuant to GCC Clause 23.
The bidder should upload the compatibility for the specification separately for which he/she is bidding.
The bidder shall bear all damages while transporting or shifting to stores, if there is any damage.
FINANCIAL BID WILL BE OPENED ONLY AFTER THE COMPLETE EVALUATION OF TECHNICAL BID
FOR ANY CLARIFICATION BIDDERS MAY CONTACT THE DIRECTOR, INFORMAITON AND COMMUNICATION DIVISION, UNIVERSITY OF MYSORE, MANASAGANGOTRI, MYSURU-570 006
INTERESTED BIDDER HAS T GO THROUGH THE TENDER DOCUMENT BEFORE BIDDING.

Manufacturer Authorization Form: If the tenderer is an Authorized dealer/reseller, the manufacturers authorization form should be submitted for laptops Manufacturers authorization is mandatory. Any bids submitted by an authorized dealer or reseller without a valid authorization will result in disqualification
Compliance statement of bidder should be on their letterhead for the tender technical specifications and clarification as per format

The bidder shall submit a request letter at least one week prior to the site visit and visit the Information and Communication Division (ICD) to understand the requirements for developing the AMC Tracking System Software. The bidder shall prepare a Solution Document based on the site visit and discussions with the concerned officials and upload it along with the Technical Bid as a mandatory requirement.
